name: Signs, doors, mirrors and more
summary: A few small helpers: a Text sign, a Door to another scene, warnings when you use too many lights, settings to make mirrors cheaper, camera cuts that fade, and pitch for sounds.
helps: Put a sign by the door, link scenes together, and keep your scene running smoothly.
where2d: Atelier and BSA, right panel, Gizmos: Text sign and Door. Settings: Scene limits.
whereVR: Wrist menu > Objects > Gizmos > Text sign or Door

d2: Open the right panel, find Gizmos, and press Add next to Text sign.
Change the words, then try Auto Fit.
Add a Door, pick a scene, turn Gizmos live on and press Go.
vr: Open the wrist menu and press Objects, then Gizmos, then Text sign. Put it where you want the sign.
Tap it to change the words or the size.
Add a Door, tap it and press Go.
use: a sign can hold up to 1000 letters
Auto Fit makes the letters smaller so all the words fit
a door only opens when you press Go, and only while Gizmos live is on
a friend only sees doors to scenes you shared
camera cuts fade over a short moment and never flash
a warning shows when you have more than 20 lights.

changes.note: You can now add a Text sign and a Door to another scene, so add one from Gizmos, then set the words or pick a scene.
